objective: Eliminate the checkpoint-derived 16-pattern PWP payload from DRAM by reconstructing each partition's exact PWP vectors on chip along a minimum-Hamming spanning tree.

materializer.algorithm: deterministic Prim minimum spanning tree over implicit zero plus 16 pattern masks
materializer.datapath: one signed weight-vector add or subtract per cycle over one 96-lane output block
materializer.descriptor_fields: parent[4:0], child[4:0], xor_mask[15:0], six reserved bits

required_proofs: all 27,648 checkpoint-bound pattern/partition PWP vectors reconstruct bit-exactly against direct INT8 summation
every reconstructed value remains in signed12 range
MST flip count and generator-cycle distribution over all 1,728 partitions
fixed-PWP versus tree metadata and DRAM byte accounting
generator plus weight/metadata load never exceeds the prior 960-cycle next-partition PWP DMA envelope

admitted_if_pass: derived-PWP DRAM payload elimination and byte reduction
bounded module-side hidden materialization under the frozen M251 phase envelope
not_admitted: power or energy without PTPX/DRAM energy measurement
full module RTL, VCS, DC, Formality, SRAM macro, paper PPA, or headline
